runtime.execution_preference: maximum feasible CUDA offload; exact requested and observed execution recorded

reliability_gates.gross_sentence_count_target: at least 90% of usable outputs contain 2-4 sentences
reliability_gates.rationale: Overview is supplementary and safely retryable, so rare safe failures are tolerable; misleading output is not. Structural reference invalidity and silent context loss are never accepted.

stopping_rules.stage_1: Do not advance clear mechanical failures. Advance candidates satisfying every Stage-1 reliability gate.
stopping_rules.stage_2: One confirmed material scientific-integrity violation is sufficient to classify the exact configuration not qualified; preserve the output and adjudication.
stopping_rules.stage_3: Run holdout only after Stage-2 human integrity review passes. Do not tune after holdout.
stopping_rules.search: Do not stop at the first passing artifact until an independent comparison in the smallest passing size tier is adjudicated.
stopping_rules.all_fail: Do not weaken gates; classify failure patterns and extend the model search or revise the task contract as a separately versioned study.
stopping_rules.all_pass: Audit fixture/control sensitivity before accepting the result.
